name: Grid
summary: This EA implements a classic grid trading strategy that places buy and sell pending orders at fixed price intervals above and below the current market price. It aims to profit from price oscillations within a range by closing positions when they reach a configurable take-profit target, while continuously maintaining the grid of orders.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了一种经典的网格交易策略，在当前市场价格上方和下方以固定价格间隔放置买入和卖出挂单。它通过在价格震荡区间内平仓获利来盈利，同时持续维持网格订单。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用网格交易策略，核心概念是在价格上下方按固定间隔布置买卖挂单，形成价格网格。入场条件是基于预设的网格间距(GridStep)，在当前价格上下方等距放置买入限价单和卖出限价单。出场条件是当任一网格订单的盈利达到设定的止盈目标(TakeProfit)时平仓，部分实现会设置止损但许多网格EA不设止损。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或根据网格层级递增手数的方式下单。资金管理方面，大多数网格EA缺乏有效的回撤控制机制，依赖价格在区间内震荡来获利。该策略在震荡市中表现良好，但在单边趋势行情中可能因不断加仓而导致严重亏损甚至爆仓。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a grid trading strategy where the core concept is placing buy and sell pending orders at fixed intervals above and below the current price, forming a price grid. Entry conditions are based on a predefined grid step distance, placing buy limit orders below and sell limit orders above the current market price. Exit conditions trigger when any grid order reaches a configurable take-profit target, though many grid EAs lack proper stop-loss mechanisms. Position sizing typically uses either fixed lot sizes or incrementally increasing lots at deeper grid levels. Money management is generally weak, as most grid EAs lack effective drawdown control and rely on price oscillating within a range to generate profits. The strategy performs well in ranging markets but can lead to catastrophic losses or account blow-up during strong trending conditions due to continuously adding positions in the losing direction.
pros: 在震荡行情中能够持续获利，利用价格波动反复止盈
策略逻辑简单直观，参数少易于理解和调优
可以24小时自动运行无需人工干预，适合非趋势市场
网格密度和间距可灵活调整以适应不同品种和波动率
pros_en: Generates consistent profits in ranging/sideways markets by capturing price oscillations repeatedly
Simple and intuitive strategy logic with few parameters, easy to understand and optimize
Can run 24/7 automatically without manual intervention, suitable for non-trending markets
Grid density and spacing are flexible and adjustable for different instruments and volatility levels
cons: 单边趋势行情中会不断逆势加仓，可能导致巨大浮亏甚至爆仓
缺乏有效止损机制，风险敞口理论上无限大
资金占用随网格层数增加而线性增长，对账户资金要求高
不设止损是网格EA最大缺陷，持续亏损仓位会耗尽保证金
cons_en: Continuously adds positions against the trend during strong directional moves, potentially causing massive drawdowns or account liquidation
Lacks effective stop-loss mechanisms, with theoretically unlimited risk exposure
Capital requirement grows linearly with grid levels, demanding significant account balance
Absence of stop-loss is the greatest flaw, as accumulating losing positions can deplete all margin
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器(如均线或ATR)，在强趋势行情中暂停开新网格单或减少网格密度
加入最大浮亏限制和整体账户回撤保护，达到阈值时强制平仓所有网格单
引入动态网格间距，根据ATR或波动率自适应调整网格密度以适应不同市场状态
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average or ATR) to pause opening new grid orders or reduce grid density during strong trending conditions
Implement maximum floating loss limits and overall account drawdown protection that force-close all grid positions when thresholds are breached
Introduce dynamic grid spacing that adapts grid density based on ATR or volatility to accommodate different market regimes

risk_points: 无有效止损机制，单边行情可能导致爆仓
逆势加仓导致浮亏呈指数级增长
资金需求随网格层数线性增加，保证金不足时会触发强制平仓
缺乏回撤控制，可能在小账户上迅速亏光
risk_points_en: No effective stop-loss mechanism; strong trends can cause account liquidation
Counter-trend position accumulation leads to exponentially growing floating losses
Capital requirements grow linearly with grid levels; insufficient margin triggers forced liquidation
Lack of drawdown control can rapidly wipe out small accounts

It aims to profit from price oscillations within a range by closing positions when they reach a configurable take-profit target, while continuously maintaining the grid of orders.
